notes: repo-561 kestra: NOT_COMPATIBLE. Dockerfile is an overlay on an external base image with no application build; reference setup needs the Docker socket.
repo-562 Part-DB: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION. Default SQLite and uploads volumes; set PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL.
repo-563 Lychee: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION. Self-contained; pgsql and env setup; worker is the same image with LYCHEE_MODE=worker.
repo-564 lago-api: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION. Rails with PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq worker, S3 gem.
repo-565 open-webui: NOT_COMPATIBLE. Local data dir state by default and heavy ML image.
repo-566 openfga: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION. Needs run command and PostgreSQL datastore; migrate command exists.
repo-567 cloudreve: NOT_COMPATIBLE. Dockerfile copies a prebuilt binary, runs aria2, data volume.
repo-568 dokploy: NOT_COMPATIBLE. Needs Docker socket and Swarm control.
repo-569 activepieces: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION. PostgreSQL, Redis, separate worker mode of same image; unsandboxed mode.
repo-570 dex: NOT_COMPATIBLE. Baked config is a dev example with SQLite; real use needs a mounted config file.
uncertainties: Part-DB and Lychee: local upload volumes are treated as optional, so verdict is NEEDS_CONFIGURATION, not NOT_COMPATIBLE.
Dex and open-webui NOT_COMPATIBLE rests on the local-disk-state and mounted-config non-goals; a stricter or looser reading could differ.
Optional Redis (Lychee, open-webui) labelled false; optional PostgreSQL labelled true where the app supports it as a database choice.
migration omitted for apps that only migrate automatically inside the app (open-webui, dex, kestra, activepieces, cloudreve).
lago-api port 3000 is the Puma/Rails default, not an explicit EXPOSE; kestra healthPath omitted (management port).
